**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Base Terms contain no minimum purchase commitment, committed volume, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic binding Bluefly:

- **§ 4.1 Charges** — Charges are only for Services specified in Service Option Attachments/Order Forms and may be one-time, installment, recurring or usage-based; nothing establishes a floor. This satisfies the **preferred** position (fees for usage or ordered services only).
- **§ 11.5 Capacity Planning** — allocates responsibility for sizing/requesting capacity to Customer, but imposes no committed capacity or volume cap.
- **§ 12.3** — no goods are sold or leased, so no purchase quantity obligation.
- **§ 3.4** — Bluefly may terminate for convenience at the end of any calendar month on one month's notice, and **§ 13.1** gives a no-charge exit on IBM service changes, so there is no multi-year lock-in.

Noted in the rationale rather than flagged: § 3.4(b) preserves "early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments," and § 3.2 auto-renews each Service Option Attachment absent 90 days' notice. The attachments should be reviewed to confirm they carry no minimum-volume or take-or-pay pricing; if they do, this rule would be re-assessed against those documents.
